blocks.text: Every page in the main namespace of the Incubator whose title begins Wp/nyn/: the test of a Runyankore Wikipedia. All of them are kept, whether or not they mention Uganda. Views are from July 2015; sizes are the current size of each page.

items.b: 2,193 pages on Runyankore on the Incubator mention Uganda, written from 2022 onward and read 305,663 times since July 2015. The median page has been read 52 times.
“Wp/nyn/Orubaju Rukuru” alone holds 3.7% of all views, and the ten most read pages hold 8%. Readership is spread across many pages rather than a few.
Views peaked in 2025 at 22,017. The last full year, 2025, drew 22,017, close to the peak. So far in 2026: 279,994 views.
Most pages were written in 2026 (1521). In the last five calendar years (2022–2026, the last one part-way) 2,193 pages were written, against 0 in the five years before that — the pace is picking up.
383 registered accounts have edited these pages in all. Editors peaked in 2026 (318); in 2025 there were 100.
